rom.note: Recorded evidence-only. It is NOT present in app/src/main/assets/profiles/heart_and_soul.json sha256Hashes and does NOT unlock live memory; see docs/HNS_2_0_5_CALCULATOR_CAPABILITY.md section 13.7.

harness.golden_assertion: scenarios 60/61/62 use `golden-grind`, a permissive RNG grind whose acceptance is a single machine-asserted [GOLDEN-HIT] PASS line. It constrains the live species, the live raw Defense word, the attacker's live level, the setup move (Golden C's Leer) and the exact observed damage, and it requires the target not to faint. It writes nothing and uses ordinary controller input only.
harness.rom_sha256_note: Every evidence run prints the SHA-256 of the ROM file it actually loaded, so the committed raw log is cryptographically bound to the same bytes the JSON's rom.sha256 records. The chain is raw log -> exact SHA -> evidence JSON -> host oracle. It is evidence bookkeeping only and does NOT promote the product trust hash or touch RuntimeRomTrust.

goldens.name: STAB and type effectiveness

attacker.ability_damage_role: neutral: attacker at 11/23 HP, above the 1/3-HP pinch threshold

goldens.modifiers: STAB x1.5 then Grass-vs-Flying resistance x0.5 (Grass vs Normal is 1.0). Without STAB the range would be 4..5; without the resistance it would be 12..15.
goldens.notes: Razor Leaf has a high critical-hit ratio; the asserted hit is the non-critical low roll (damage 6), which the golden-grind command accepts only because it lies inside the documented 6..7 non-critical range. The scenario fights until Razor Leaf is learned at L6, then flees non-matching encounters so the attacker stays L6 (Atk 13), and stops with exit 0 on the asserted hit.

goldens.name: live non-neutral stat stage

attacker.ability_damage_role: neutral: attacker at 20/21 HP immediately before Scratch, above the 1/3-HP pinch threshold (Torrent is irrelevant here because Scratch is Normal-type)

goldens.stage_materiality: At live Def stage -1 the raw Def 6 becomes 4 and the rolls are 9..11. At stage 0 the rolls are 6..8, which EXCLUDES the observed 10; the host test asserts that exclusion.
goldens.notes: The raw Def stage was read live from gBattleMons[defender].statStages by the production reader immediately before the hit; the [GOLDEN-HIT] PASS line records defenderDefStage=-1. The values here describe the hit frame exactly as logged: the attacker stood at 20/21 HP immediately before Scratch (the Leer turn cost it 1 HP), and the encountered Pidgey was level 2. Neither is a damage operand for this request (defender level is not read by the calculator; Scratch is Normal, so Torrent cannot apply).

c4e_live_operand_observation.why: The first production-authorized ordinary Singles subset needs the neutral value of every mutable operand added in C4e: no Ion Deluge / Electrify retype, no Glaive Rush, no active gimmick, no live status, an authoritative HP/maxHP pair for the pinch-ability threshold, and observed neutral field conditions (clear weather, no defender-side Reflect / Light Screen). All of those are observed on the exact official ROM at the Golden A hit frame.
c4e_live_operand_observation.positive_transition_note: A positive transition (e.g. an active Electrify, Glaive Rush or Tera frame) was not produced, so the active/positive behavior remains SOURCE + HOST reasoned and runtime-refused, not runtime-verified. The source-derived ABI plus an observed neutral zero is the evidence the neutral subset is authorized on.

indirect_observations.name: critical hit (indirect)
indirect_observations.observed: The second Tackle in the original Golden A battle took the wild Pidgey from 10 HP to 0 (delta capped by the faint).
indirect_observations.why_indirect: No critical-hit bit or message was read directly, and the target fainted, so the exact critical roll is unobservable (the faint caps the delta at the 10 remaining HP). The reasoning is the exclusion: the non-critical maximum is 7, so a >=10 HP drop cannot be an ordinary hit, and a critical (11..14) can account for it. This is NOT one of the A/B/C direct roll goldens and must not be counted with them.
indirect_observations.log_note: evidence/golden-e-crit-indirect.log is the preserved original Golden A capture; the direct Golden A record was re-captured with the SHA-emitting harness and is evidence/golden-a-neutral-tackle.log.
